title: Install Nekogenix
description: Install Nekogenix with the official Minecraft Launcher, Prism Launcher, Modrinth App or CurseForge App.

sections.title: Before you start
list: A Microsoft account with access to Minecraft Java Edition.
A Nekogenix release compatible with your profile’s Minecraft version. Other mods in that profile must also support its Minecraft version and NeoForge.
NeoForge for that Minecraft version. Use a loader build that meets the requirements of your chosen Nekogenix release.
sections.notice: Before adding mods to an existing world, close the game and copy its folder from saves to a separate backup location.

sections.title: Download the mod and choose your launcher
paragraphs: Close Minecraft before adding mod files. Follow the steps for your launcher: [Minecraft Launcher](wiki/getting-started#official-launcher), [Prism Launcher](wiki/getting-started#prism-launcher), [Modrinth App](wiki/getting-started#modrinth) or [CurseForge App](wiki/getting-started#curseforge).
list: Open [Nekogenix releases on GitHub](https://github.com/nekogenix/nekogenix-mod/releases). Choose a release and read its Minecraft, NeoForge and dependency requirements.
Expand Assets under that release and download the Nekogenix file ending in .jar.
Keep the JAR in your downloads folder. Do not extract or run it: you will copy it into your game profile. If the release lists required dependency mods, download compatible files for those too.

sections.title: Official Minecraft Launcher
list: In [Minecraft Launcher](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/download), open Minecraft: Java Edition → Installations and select the profile you want to use. If you do not have one yet, create it with New installation for a Minecraft version supported by the mod.

Check that a compatible NeoForge version is installed. If needed, close the launcher, download the matching installer from [NeoForge](https://neoforged.net/), open it with Java and select Install client → Proceed. The [NeoForge guide](https://docs.neoforged.net/user/docs/) covers Java requirements; launch the matching vanilla Minecraft version once if the installer requests it.
Open the profile’s three-dot menu → Edit. In Version, select the compatible NeoForge entry if it is not already selected. Enable the Modded filter in Installations if the profile is hidden.

Check Game directory in the profile settings: this is where its mods and worlds are stored. Keep the directory used by your existing profile. If the field is empty, the profile uses the default .minecraft directory.
Save the settings and use the folder button beside this profile in Installations to open its game directory. Open mods, or create that folder if it is missing.
Copy the downloaded Nekogenix JAR and any required dependency JARs into mods. Leave the mod files directly in that folder, without extracting them.
Select this profile in the launcher and start the game.

sections.title: Prism Launcher
list: Select the instance you want to use in [Prism Launcher](https://prismlauncher.org/download/). If you do not have one yet, use Add Instance and choose a compatible Minecraft version and NeoForge.
Right-click the instance → Edit → Version. Check its Minecraft and NeoForge versions against the Nekogenix release requirements. If NeoForge is missing, install it from this tab.
In the same editor, open Mods. Drag the downloaded Nekogenix JAR into the list and add any required dependency JARs in the same way.
Check that the added mods appear in the list and their checkboxes are enabled.
Close the editor and launch this instance.

sections.title: Modrinth App
list: Open the instance you want to use in [Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app). If you do not have one yet, use Create instance → Custom setup and choose a compatible Minecraft version and NeoForge.
In the instance settings, check the Minecraft version, Loader and Loader version against the Nekogenix release requirements. Wait for any pending game or loader installation to finish.
From the instance’s action menu, choose Open folder. Open mods, creating the folder if necessary, and copy in the Nekogenix JAR plus any required dependency JARs.
Return to the instance’s Content tab. Check that the added mods are listed and enabled.
Click Play for this instance.

sections.title: CurseForge App
list: In [CurseForge App](https://www.curseforge.com/download/app), open Minecraft → My Modpacks and select your profile. If you do not have one yet, click Create and choose a compatible Minecraft version and NeoForge.
Check the profile’s Minecraft and NeoForge versions against the Nekogenix release requirements. Wait for any pending installation to finish.
Open the profile’s three-dot menu → Open Folder. Open mods, or create that folder if it is missing.
Copy the downloaded Nekogenix JAR and any required dependency JARs into mods. Leave the files directly in that folder, without extracting them.
Click Play for this profile. If Minecraft Launcher opens, launch the profile prepared by CurseForge.

sections.title: Play on a server
paragraphs: Install Nekogenix in your launcher using one of the methods above. Use the Minecraft version, NeoForge build and Nekogenix release required by the server.
The server owner also needs a NeoForge server with the matching Nekogenix JAR and required server dependencies in its mods folder. Stop the server before changing these files.

title: Craft and clean a syringe
description: Make the plunger, barrel and needle, assemble the syringe, and clean it after use.

sections.title: 1. Craft the plunger
paragraphs: Place a slimeball above a stick in the crafting grid.

sections.title: 2. Craft the barrel
paragraphs: Use six glass blocks and one glass pane. Leave the top and middle slots of the centre column empty.

sections.title: 3. Craft the needle
paragraphs: Place three iron nuggets in a vertical line.

sections.title: 4. Assemble the syringe
paragraphs: Place the plunger at the bottom left, the barrel in the centre, and the needle at the top right. Fill the finished syringe at the [pneumatic stand](wiki/laboratory#pneumatic).

sections.title: Clean a used syringe
list: Place a cauldron above any heat source (fire, soul fire, lava, a magma block, a lit campfire or a lit soul campfire), then fill it completely with water.
Drop one used syringe into the cauldron.
Wait 10 seconds and collect the clean syringe. Refill the cauldron before cleaning the next one.

title: Prepare a Neko Injection
description: Collect cat saliva, make a cat nucleocard, and fill one or two syringes.

sections.title: Prepare the equipment
paragraphs: You will need a brewing stand, a centrifuge, a pneumatic stand and [one or two empty syringes](wiki/recipes). One batch can fill two syringes, so prepare both for a paired injection.

sections.title: 1. Collect and bottle cat saliva
list: Tame a cat with raw cod or salmon. Craft cotton swabs using the recipe below.
Use a cotton swab on your tamed cat to get a Cat Saliva Swab. Collect two samples.
[Brew the samples into bottles of saliva](wiki/potions#saliva). Collect six bottles for the centrifuge.

sections.title: 2. Make a cat nucleocard
paragraphs: Craft a Blank Nucleocard, then open the centrifuge. Load the six saliva bottles, the card and a stack of redstone dust. Wait for the cycle to finish and collect the Cat Nucleocard.

sections.title: 3. Fill the syringes
paragraphs: Open the pneumatic stand. Put the Cat Nucleocard in its source slot, add a wind charge and place an empty syringe in each position you want to fill. Collect the Neko Injections when processing finishes.

sections.title: Use the finished injection
paragraphs: Follow the [transformation steps](wiki/transformation#inject) to use your dose. If you want to remain a neko, prepare the [Crystallizing Injection](wiki/transformation#prepare-stabilizer) before starting.

title: Bottles and brewing
description: Brew cat saliva and Sweet Amethyst, then make their splash and lingering forms.

sections.title: Prepare the brewing stand
paragraphs: Craft a brewing stand and glass bottles. Add blaze powder to the fuel slot: one powder powers 20 brewing cycles. The stand can brew up to three bottles with one ingredient.
The brewing stand recipe shown uses cobblestone. Blackstone and cobbled deepslate also work.

sections.title: Bottle cat saliva
paragraphs: Collect a [sample from your tamed cat](wiki/laboratory#sample). Put empty glass bottles in the three lower slots and a Cat Saliva Swab above them. Brew twice to obtain the six bottles needed for a [Cat Nucleocard](wiki/laboratory#centrifuge).
sections.notice: Use empty bottles, without water. One swab can fill up to three bottles.

sections.title: Splash cat saliva
paragraphs: Brew gunpowder into Bottles of Cat Saliva to make the splash form.

sections.title: Lingering cat saliva
paragraphs: Add Dragon’s Breath to the splash bottles. The empty breath bottle is returned.

sections.title: Brew Sweet Amethyst
paragraphs: Collect honey from a full bee nest or beehive using a glass bottle. Put the Honey Bottles in the brewing stand and add an Amethyst Shard. The finished potion is also used to prepare a [Crystallizing Injection](wiki/transformation#prepare-stabilizer).

sections.title: Splash Sweet Amethyst
paragraphs: Add gunpowder to Potions of Sweet Amethyst.

sections.title: Lingering Sweet Amethyst
paragraphs: Add Dragon’s Breath to the splash potions. The empty breath bottle is returned.

title: Become a cat or stay a neko
description: Use an injection, follow the stages, and stop at neko form if you choose.

sections.title: Take the injection
list: Prepare a [Neko Injection](wiki/laboratory), food and a safe place to wait.
Hold the injection in your main hand. Hold Use Item (right mouse button by default) until the animation finishes.
The used syringe remains in your hand and Neko Sickness begins. Wait for the transformation stages below.
sections.notice: The needle causes a little damage. Recover your health before injecting.

sections.title: Transformation stages
paragraphs: A single dose takes about 81 minutes of play to complete.
list: Neko Sickness — 1 minute.
Three ability stages — 20 minutes each. Agility, Feline Vision and Soft Paws appear in a random order.
Cat Transformation — 20 minutes. This is the stage when you can stop and stay a neko.
Cat form — the transformation is complete and Feline Scent becomes available.

sections.title: Transform faster with two injections
paragraphs: Put one Neko Injection in each hand. Hold Use Item, then also hold Attack (left mouse button by default) until both injections finish.
Sickness lasts 3 minutes; each ability stage and Cat Transformation lasts 5 minutes. The total is about 23 minutes.

sections.title: Prepare the stopping injection
list: Prepare a [Potion of Sweet Amethyst](wiki/potions#sweet-amethyst) from a Honey Bottle and an Amethyst Shard.
Put the potion in the pneumatic stand’s source slot. Add a wind charge and one or two empty syringes.
Collect the Crystallizing Injection and keep a bucket of milk ready for after use.

sections.title: Stop and stay a neko
paragraphs: Wait until all three abilities have appeared and the Cat Transformation effect is active. Use the Crystallizing Injection before that effect ends. You will permanently stay a neko with your acquired abilities.
This choice is permanent: another Neko Injection will not resume the process. Once you are fully a cat, this injection cannot turn you back.
sections.notice: Crystallization lasts 60 seconds, sharply slows movement and can kill you. Drink the prepared milk to remove this effect. Drinking Sweet Amethyst itself does not stop transformation.

sections.title: Nine lives
paragraphs: You receive nine feline lives when Cat Transformation begins. In Survival, the first eight deaths preserve your feline state; the ninth returns you to human form. Dying earlier in the process cancels the transformation.
sections.notice: Hardcore still ends on death, even if you have feline lives remaining.

title: Use feline abilities
description: How to double-jump, see in darkness, reduce fall damage and find creatures by scent.

sections.title: Double-jump and faster movement
paragraphs: Agility doubles your sprinting and sneaking speed. Jump from the ground, then press Jump again while you are still rising to make a second, stronger leap.
sections.notice: Keep your hunger above three drumsticks to double-jump.

sections.title: See in darkness
paragraphs: Feline Vision activates automatically near dark places. It brightens your view when exploring caves or travelling at night.
For manual control, change the vision mode and assign its key in [settings](wiki/settings#keys).

sections.title: Land safely with Soft Paws
paragraphs: Soft Paws reduces fall damage by 75%. Once you reach neko form, falls of less than ten blocks deal no damage. Higher falls can still hurt.

sections.title: Find creatures by scent
paragraphs: In full cat form, stay crouched for three seconds. Nearby creatures become outlined through walls, including those up to 30 blocks away horizontally and 15 blocks above or below you.
list: Red — hostile creatures.
Yellow — neutral creatures.
Green — passive creatures, creepers and phantoms.
White — other players.

title: Play as a cat
description: Use your equipment, move through small passages, choose food and interact with creatures.

sections.title: Items, armour and elytra
paragraphs: Your inventory and equipment stay with you after transformation. Use tools, place blocks, open containers and wear armour as usual. Elytra also work in cat form.

sections.title: Walk on four paws or stand upright
paragraphs: Adjust [Camera Height](wiki/settings#camera) to choose a low, four-paw posture or an upright one. Cats can fit into one-block-high passages and sprint through them.

sections.title: Choose food
paragraphs: From neko form onward, raw meat is as nourishing as cooked meat. Raw chicken no longer causes Hunger. Many plant foods are less filling, and hunger depletes more slowly.
sections.notice: Avoid cakes, cookies and other sweets, just as you would avoid rotten flesh and other harmful food in normal gameplay.

sections.title: Creepers, phantoms and kittens
paragraphs: Creepers avoid you once you are a neko, and phantoms no longer spawn for you.
In full cat form, another player can feed you raw cod or salmon. Two fed cat players, or a fed cat player and a tamed cat, can breed and have a kitten.

title: Choose or import a cat skin
description: Apply a Minecraft cat coat or add your own texture with the skin editor.

sections.title: Choose a Minecraft cat coat
list: Open Mods → Nekogenix → Config → Cat Skin.
Select one of the 11 Minecraft cat coats. Rotate and zoom the preview to inspect it.
Hover over the coat’s card and click the checkmark labelled Use to apply it.

sections.title: Import your own skin
list: Choose New Skin. Use Download Skin Template for a colour guide to the body parts, then draw your texture as a 64 × 32 pixel PNG no larger than 16 KiB.
Choose Upload Skin and open your PNG, or drag the file onto the editor.
Check the skin in four-paw, upright and sitting poses. Give it a name.
Choose Save to keep it in the library, or Save and Use to apply it immediately.

sections.title: Manage saved skins
paragraphs: Select a saved skin to preview, rename, apply or delete it. Your library can hold up to 32 custom skins.

sections.title: Applying a skin
paragraphs: Applying a coat requires an internet connection and a verified Minecraft account. You can edit and preview skins offline.
sections.notice: If account verification fails, reconnect to the internet and sign in again through your launcher.

title: Change settings and controls
description: Adjust camera height, feline voice, double-jump and vision controls.

sections.title: Open the settings
paragraphs: Open Mods → Nekogenix → Config from the title menu or while playing.

sections.title: Adjust camera height and posture
paragraphs: Move Camera Height towards 0 to lower your view or towards 100 for human eye level. In cat form, values from 0 to 40 put you on four paws; higher values use an upright posture.

sections.title: Set double-jump and vision controls
list: Use Neko Double Jump to enable or disable the second jump.
Leave Feline Vision on Automatic, or choose Manual to switch it yourself.
In Minecraft’s Options → Controls → Key Binds, find Nekogenix and assign the vision toggle. You can also assign a double-jump toggle. Neither has a key assigned by default.

sections.title: Adjust feline voice volume
paragraphs: Lower Neko Voice to make meowing and purring quieter, or set it to zero to mute them. This slider is also available in Minecraft’s sound options.

title: Solve common problems
description: Check an injection that did not work, missing abilities, milk effects or a stalled machine.

sections.title: The injection did not start transformation
paragraphs: Check that you are holding a filled Neko Injection. Hold Use Item until the entire animation finishes. An empty syringe or a Bottle of Cat Saliva will not start transformation.

sections.title: A machine will not start
list: Centrifuge: check all six saliva bottles, a Blank Nucleocard and 64 redstone dust.
Pneumatic stand: check the source, a wind charge and at least one empty syringe. The full process is in [injection preparation](wiki/laboratory#pneumatic).

sections.title: An ability does not work
list: Abilities arrive one at a time during transformation. Check the [stage you have reached](wiki/transformation#stages).
For double-jump, eat first, check that it is enabled, then jump from the ground and press Jump again promptly.
For manual vision, [assign its key](wiki/settings#keys). Scent requires full cat form and three seconds of crouching.

sections.title: What happens if I drink milk?
paragraphs: Milk does not reverse transformation or remove feline abilities. It causes poison during early transformation and nausea in neko form.
It does remove temporary effects such as Sweetness and Crystallization. This makes it useful after the [stopping injection](wiki/transformation#stabilize).

sections.title: The stopping dose did not work
paragraphs: Use the filled Crystallizing Injection during Cat Transformation, before you become a full cat. If you drank Sweet Amethyst instead, [prepare the injection](wiki/transformation#prepare-stabilizer) from it at the pneumatic stand.
